installed.copies_note: Every installed binary is byte-identical to the game's payload: Uninstaller.exe is ACE-Setup64.exe, and ACE-CORE1/2<game id>.sys are ACE-CORE.sys and ACE-CORE.sys2.

install.runtime_state: While the game ran, ACE-BASE was running and AntiCheatExpert Protection stopped; once it closed, both were stopped, and system32/drivers/ACE-BASE.sys stayed on disk.
